title: Prospective Points of Comparison and Qualification Design for F3 True Adaptive Spatial Ladder

prospective_points_of_comparison.evaluation_approach: Compute paired discrepancies: Coarse vs Medium, Medium vs Fine, and Coarse vs Fine over the full [0, 8.35] s window at 836 matching frames. Evaluate spatial order of accuracy p = ln((E_coarse - E_medium)/(E_medium - E_fine)) / ln(r).

prospective_points_of_comparison.dimension: Boundary layer resolution and particle retention
prospective_points_of_comparison.details: With 3 layers of mDBC particles on 5 closed faces, the effective boundary resolution scales with DP (0.015m, 0.010m, 0.0075m). Track near-wall velocity gradient du/dz, shear stress, and whether bottom layer fluid particles stay confined to their streamline separatrix.

prospective_points_of_comparison.dimension: Canonical transport chords and fate stability
prospective_points_of_comparison.details: Evaluate discrete center-plane (x=0) crossing events across resolutions. Because particle identities are resolution-specific cohorts (4,320 vs 14,580 vs 34,560), compare aggregate transport observables: cumulative signed crossing count, net exchange mass M_net(t), residence time distribution p95, and destination state shares.

prospective_points_of_comparison.dimension: Timestep telemetry and adaptive floor margin
prospective_points_of_comparison.details: Verify for both coarse and medium that total DT adjustments remain 0 and floor incidence fraction is 0.0% (PASS < 1% budget). Confirm native dt_min > CoefDtMin * h / speedsound so that SPH timestepping remains strictly CFL-governed rather than floor-clamped.

background_1_cell3.status: candidate numerical family defined (adaptive CFL 0.05 / CoefDtMin 0.005); spatial ladder coarse/medium prepared; fine completed; temporal ladder completed (836 vs 4176 frames); Q-N pending full 2x3 evidence.

background_2_eccentric_baffle.status: planned; geometry defined; solver pending live resource lease.

independent_qualification_path.study_alias_clarification: No 336-case claim is made from study aliases or postprocessing permutations. The 336-case label is an unassessed global placeholder (Q-N 0/336). Derived cadences (0.01s vs 0.002s), integration variants (native adaptive vs fixed-dt), and diagnostic re-runs are validation instruments, not separate physical parameter endpoints.

rejection_of_historical_fixed_dt.historical_issue: Executed with CoefDtMin=0.05 which clamped dt at the floor for 100% of steps, equivalent to fixed-dt. It is NOT equivalent to genuine adaptive SPH timestepping.
rejection_of_historical_fixed_dt.resolution: Superseded by new adaptive case F3_CELL3_LONG_DP0100_ADAPTIVE_CFL05_COEF005 with decoupled CoefDtMin=0.005.
